summary: Whole sector faces $300B patent cliff by 2030. Merck's Keytruda at peak $32B sales facing biosimilar pressure. AbbVie successfully navigated Humira cliff. Pfizer acquired Metsera (obesity) and initiating 10 Phase 3 trials. IBD combination therapy race: AbbVie, Lilly, Pfizer, Merck all competing in same space as JNJ's JNJ-4804. JNJ targeting $100B revenue milestone in 2026.
